entries.requirement: Answer system health, degradation, changes, needs Joe, and agent activity in under fifteen seconds.
Stale or missing telemetry must render Unknown, never cached Healthy.
rollback: remove bad fixture or collector from authoritative set

entries.requirement: Control Room uses a separate authentication audience, origin, and cookie.
Phase 0 is read-only and exposes no mutation, approval, grant, actuator, or production route.
Services expose purpose, owner, workflows, dependencies, health sources, versions, environments, and runbooks.
Work Requests preserve business origin and acceptance criteria and return a safe lifecycle summary to Workspace.
Agent Sessions are scoped envelopes that start read-only and never inherit production authority.
Material plan revision creates a new hash and invalidates prior approval.
rollback: supersede only; never edit immutable revision

entries.requirement: Production approval is Joe-only at launch, requires fresh re-authentication, and browser actors never execute.
A deployment is not Complete until the target version reads back and named golden workflows pass.
Browser disconnect does not own, create, cancel, or hide long-running work; reconnect replays authoritative server events.
rollback: abort or rollback remains a separate typed server state

entries.requirement: Incidents separate facts from hypotheses and require monitoring proof before resolution.
Audit reconstructs origin through verification with immutable IDs and declared redaction.
rollback: append compensating event; no update or delete

entries.requirement: Existing deploy, migration, health, smoke, probe, backup, and restore wrappers remain the only actuator families.
rollback: existing wrapper rollback or named forward fix

entries.requirement: Business content remains in Workspace; Control Room stores only authorized refs and safe labels.
Offline views are read-only, timestamped, and cannot show Healthy without fresh evidence.
All prototype surfaces support authored non-happy states, keyboard access, high contrast, reduced motion, and color-independent Production labeling.
Every screen displays support context and telemetry excludes secrets and client payloads.

Routine operating work is adopted only when Joe or Dell can complete and understand it without opening Claude Code or Codex, with measured baseline and explicit retirement of the displaced session ritual.
authority: coding agents handle exploration, complex investigation, and construction
rollback: restore the prior routine during the observation window without running two permanent truths

entries.requirement: Nonterminal human-decision, blocker, failure, and revision states have explicit guarded productive re-entry paths without inheriting or widening authority.
api_or_action: future server-enforced state transition; absent from the Phase 0 read API
rollback: unlisted or insufficiently evidenced transition defaults to refusal

entries.requirement: Control Room Phase 0 remains a no-mutation foundation for the thin authoritative read-first Control Room inside CARR Mature Foundation v1; it also specifies the Local Edge Node as a registered, replaceable, non-authoritative service with bounded hardware, identity, observability, recovery, and human purchase gates. Production-mutable AgentOps is deferred to the evidence-gated 4–6-month integrated program and cannot begin before Joe approves the three-model council output.
api_or_action: future construction remains absent pending Joe's approval of the council output
authority: Phase 0 agents may prepare and validate only
no browser, agent, or prototype receives production mutation authority
evidence: four fresh-read doctrine identities and generations
zero mutation routes and production actions
bounded Local Edge Node purchase gate and hardware acceptance contract
rollback: revert only the planning reconciliation if a canonical doctrine read changes; preserve the no-mutation boundary

entries.requirement: Every operation is bound to an immutable server-derived tenant and environment context; cross-tenant reads, plans, approvals, capabilities, events, audit, exports, model context, and Workspace returns deny before existence disclosure.
api_or_action: future server request-context middleware and mandatory tenant/environment repository predicates; absent in Phase 0
authority: Joe administers the single launch tenant
client and agent tenant claims are never authoritative
evidence: tenant-boundary.v1.json attempts across eight exact denial paths covering ten tenant-scoped resource classes
rollback: default deny and disable affected route; never fall back to an unscoped query

entries.requirement: Provisional workflows progress experimental to pilot to approved to standard to retired through audited promotions. Every promotion, including pilot-to-approved and approved-to-standard, requires named evidence, immutable workflow version, accountable owner, completed observation window, failure criteria and handling, tested rollback, adoption result and adoption test, and cutover plan and cutover gate. Each pilot lasts at most five business days with no new source of truth, destructive migration, parallel writer, or generic workflow engine; work pins an immutable version, retired workflows block new starts, and routine controls remain usable during Doc outage. Generic workflow engines, plugin marketplaces, and customer scripting are outside the current program.
api_or_action: Phase 0 lifecycle contract only; promotion, execution, and retirement mutation routes remain absent
rollback: retire or supersede a version; re-plan active work rather than mutating pinned execution

entries.requirement: Normal internal maintenance targets 3–5 measured human hours per month, exception hours are attributed separately, two consecutive months above five open a bound toil-reduction request, and a mature claim requires three complete measured months.
api_or_action: Phase 0 accounting schema and gate only; no live time collection or toil automation claimed
rollback: correct by append-only accounting adjustment; never recategorize exceptions to change the normal target silently

entries.requirement: Every interactive or unattended agent session separately binds immutable organization tenant, verified sponsoring human and partner or explicit unsponsored status, agent principal, runtime principal, session capability profile, and personal-brain scope/version/count. Joe-sponsored Codex or Claude loads shared plus Joe-personal; Dell-sponsored loads shared plus Dell-personal; an unsponsored agent receives active shared rules and/or explicit job-scoped rules, reports personal scope none and zero personal, and never receives humanOnly capability.
api_or_action: future server identity-resolution envelope before standing-context or authorization; absent from Phase 0 production runtime
authority: server derives tenant, sponsor, agent, runtime, brain, and capability independently
verified Joe or Dell is sponsor provenance only
unsponsored agent cannot impersonate a human
evidence: Dell current 144 shared plus 0 explicitly resolved Dell-personal
rollback: return identity_scope_unknown and withhold personal briefing and humanOnly authority; never fall back from sponsor to agent slug

entries.requirement: Personal brains are isolated and non-authoritative: cross-brain reads deny, missing or ambiguous scope is visible Unknown rather than successful zero, connector/store and generated render resolve the same partner brain and counts, and personal rules cannot choose tenant, capability, identity, or silent shared promotion.
api_or_action: separately authorized standing-context sponsor resolution and generated-render parity repair is deployed; no Control Room product mutation route or Phase 0 artifact was deployed
authority: verified sponsor alone selects its matching personal brain
personal rules shape behavior but grant no tenant, identity, role, risk, capability, or promotion authority
evidence: tenant and capability widening denial fixtures
rollback: fail closed with personal_scope_mismatch, identity_scope_unknown, or identity_source_mismatch and disclose no foreign rule bodies

entries.requirement: Identity audit preserves both agent/runtime attribution and verified human sponsorship, together with organization tenant, personal-brain scope/version/count, capability profile, and result, while excluding personal rule bodies and quotes.
evidence: personal rule body and quote deny list
rollback: withhold incomplete audit projection and mark identity evidence Unknown; never substitute human as actor or emit rule content
